text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novel writer.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
Premises:
¬Podcast(x) ∨ ¬Novel(x) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
BornIn(x, americanCity) → American(x) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y) ∧ Person(y) → NovelWriter(y) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
Writer(daniShapiro) ∧ American(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(familyHistory) ∧ WrittenIn(familyHistory, year2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
Podcast(familySecrets) ∧ CreatedBy(familySecrets, daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
City(boston) ∧ American(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
BornIn(daniShapiro, boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
